sub_theme: People and Places Around the World

lessons.title: Where in the World Do We Live?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify their own country on a simple world map.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a simple world map/globe.
lessons.main_activity: Show children where they live on a map, discussing that the world is made up of many countries.
key_questions: What country do we live in?
What else can you see on the map?

differentiation.extension: Locate 2-3 other countries discussed this year

lessons.assessment_notes: Note early geographic awareness — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap where we live on the map.
lessons.home_link: Look at a map or globe together at home.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'Whoever You Are' by Mem Fox
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe one way children around the world are similar.
lessons.main_activity: Read the story, discussing how children around the world have similarities (feelings, families, play) despite differences.
key_questions: How are children around the world similar?
How might they be different?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension and empathetic understanding — evidence for LIT.1/UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Discuss the story's message about our shared humanity.
lessons.home_link: Talk about how children in other countries might live differently.

lessons.title: Making Flags from Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a flag using colour and pattern.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a few flags from countries studied this year.
lessons.main_activity: Children choose a country and make a simple flag using paint/craft materials, copying its colours and pattern.
key_questions: Which country's flag are you making?
What colours does it use?

differentiation.extension: Recreate a more detailed flag design

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe colour/pattern replication and fine motor skill — evidence for EAD.1/MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Display flags together as a 'world wall'.
lessons.home_link: Look up your family's country of origin's flag together.

lessons.title: Homes and Houses Around the World Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall that homes look different in different countries.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap Week 3's homes around the world learning.
lessons.main_activity: Look again at different home types worldwide, discussing why they might differ (climate, materials available, culture).
resources_needed: Homes around the world picture cards
key_questions: Why might homes look different in different places?
Which home type do you find most interesting?

differentiation.extension: Explain reasoning for different home designs

lessons.assessment_notes: Note deepened geographic reasoning — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.home_link: Look up a home style from another country together.

lessons.title: Writing About a Country
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write the name of a country.
lessons.main_activity: Children choose a country and attempt to write its name using known phonics sounds, alongside a drawing.
resources_needed: Paper, pencils, country name cards for reference
key_questions: Which country are you writing about?
Can you write its name?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note writing progress — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Share country writing with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Practise writing a country name together at home.

lessons.title: Music and Dance from Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to move expressively to music from a different culture.
lessons.starter_activity: Listen to a piece of music from a different country/culture.
lessons.main_activity: Children move expressively to the music, discussing how it feels different from music they usually hear.
key_questions: How does this music make you want to move?
How is it different from music you know?

differentiation.extension: Invent an original movement matching the music's rhythm

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe expressive response to unfamiliar music — evidence for EAD.2/UTW.2.
lessons.home_link: Listen to music from a different culture together.

lessons.title: Food from Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name a food eaten in a different country.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap food discussions from Diwali/Chinese New Year weeks.
lessons.main_activity: (Allergy-checked, optional) discuss/try a simple food from a different culture, or look at pictures of foods eaten around the world.
resources_needed: Pictures of world foods, optional safe tasting
key_questions: What food is this? Where is it from?
Would you like to try it?

differentiation.extension: Compare to a food eaten at home

lessons.assessment_notes: Note cultural food awareness — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.home_link: Try or look up a food from a different country together.

lessons.title: Comparing Stories from Different Cultures
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify a similarity between two stories from different cultures.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap a story from a different culture read this year (e.g. Chinese zodiac story).
lessons.main_activity: Read/discuss a folk tale from a different culture, comparing it to a familiar story's structure or message.
key_questions: What is similar about these stories?
What is different?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comparative literary reasoning — evidence for LIT.1/UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of similarities and differences found.
lessons.home_link: Ask a family member to share a story from their culture or childhood.

lessons.title: World Map Collage
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to contribute to a collaborative world map artwork.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at the class world map/globe.
lessons.main_activity: Children contribute a small piece (flag, animal, or symbol) representing a country studied, adding it to a large class world map display.
resources_needed: Large world map outline, craft materials
key_questions: What are you adding to the map?
Where does it go?

differentiation.support: Adult supports placement on the map
differentiation.extension: Explain why they chose their contribution

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe collaborative creativity and geographic awareness — evidence for EAD.1/UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Admire the completed collaborative world map.
lessons.home_link: Look at the world map display next time you're in the classroom/at pickup.

lessons.title: Languages Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say 'hello' in more than one language.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss that people around the world speak different languages.
lessons.main_activity: Learn to say 'hello' in a few different languages (including any spoken by children in the class), practising together.
key_questions: How do you say hello in this language?
What languages do you know?

differentiation.extension: Learn 3+ greetings and teach a peer

lessons.assessment_notes: Note appreciation of linguistic diversity — evidence for UTW.2/CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Practise all the greetings learned together.
lessons.home_link: Teach a family member a greeting in a different language.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading World-Themed Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read simple world-themed words.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations reading world-themed word cards and simple sentences (e.g. 'the flag is red').
key_questions: Can you read this word?
Can you read this sentence?

differentiation.support: Read simple CVC words with support

lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application to themed vocabulary — evidence for LIT.2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading world-themed words over the week.

lessons.title: World Celebration Performance Prep
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to practise a song or dance representing a culture studied this year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap favourite cultural songs/dances learned this year (Diwali, Chinese New Year).
lessons.main_activity: Practise a chosen song/dance from earlier in the year, preparing for a short performance.
resources_needed: Music player, resources from earlier weeks
key_questions: Which song/dance are you practising?
What do you remember about it?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note recall and confidence with prior learning — evidence for EAD.2.

lessons.title: People and Places Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about people and places around the world learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a class 'Our World' display combining flags, the world map collage, and languages learned.
key_questions: What have we learned about the world?
What was most interesting?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about the world with your family.

lessons.title: World Quiz Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer recall questions about people and places learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Quiz-style game asking questions about countries, flags, and languages from the week.
key_questions: How do you say hello in this language?
What flag is this?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess recall and comprehension — evidence for LIT.1/CL.1.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on world facts learned this week.

lessons.title: World Celebration Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform their chosen song/dance with confidence.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the performance piece practised on Thursday.
lessons.main_activity: Whole-class performance of the chosen song/dance, with flags and world map displayed.
resources_needed: Craft from the week, music player
key_questions: What was your favourite part of this week?
How did it feel to perform?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe confidence and enjoyment — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Round of applause; recap the world week.
lessons.home_link: Perform the song/dance for family this weekend.
